instruction:
Implement WP-SCP-022 Track 1 slice 020B as defined in `docs/plans/WP-SCP-020-policy-federation-primitive.md` §4 row 020B. Do not implement any other slice's deliverables.

This slice ships the **reusable GitHub Actions workflow** that downstream repositories will call as the federation primitive. The workflow itself does not run policy checks against real Rego rules in this slice (those land in 020C). Slice 020B's deliverable is the workflow scaffold + supporting artefacts (`scripts/verify-bypass-pairing.sh`, `schemas/policy-check-summary.schema.json`).

## Acceptance criteria (from WP-SCP-020 §4 020B)

- (i) `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml` declares `on: workflow_call` only; caller wrappers will declare `on: pull_request` only and refuse fork PRs. `inputs:` enumerated with `type:` for each: `rule-set: string (default: "starter")`, `threshold: string (default: "deny")`, `annotate: boolean (default: true)`, `scp_bypass: boolean (default: false)`, `waivers-path: string (default: "output/findings/waivers.json")`, `rule-config-path: string (default: ".scp/rule-config.yaml")`.
- (ii) No `${{ inputs.* }}` or `${{ github.event.* }}` interpolation inside any `run:` block. Pass via `env:` with quoted expansion only.
- (iii) `permissions:` is exactly `contents: read`. No `id-token`, no `checks: write`, no `pull-requests: write`.
- (iv) No `secrets:` declared on the reusable workflow itself. Adopter guidance (in 020H part 3, future slice — do NOT write that doc here) will forbid `secrets: inherit`.
- (v) All `uses:` references pinned by full 40-char commit SHA, with a comment noting the version tag. OPA/Conftest binaries: version-pinned AND SHA256-verified before execution. Use `gh attestation verify` where the upstream publisher signs (OPA v0.62+).
- (vi) NO `actions/cache` step in v1.0.0 (cache-poisoning surface closed).
- (vii) Changed-files mode is the v1.0.0 behaviour: workflow runs `git diff --name-only base..HEAD` to get the changed-file list; whole-tree audit is a future v1.1 input (do not implement here).
- (viii-a) OPA/Conftest binaries downloaded at workflow-run time with SHA256 verification + vendored fallback path under `vendor/opa/` and `vendor/conftest/` (note paths; do not actually download/commit binaries — the path is for the runtime fallback resolution).
- (viii-b) Named error codes are emitted via `::error file=...,title=SCP-EXXX::message`: SCP-E001 (infra fetch fail), SCP-E002 (bundle load fail), SCP-E003 (policy deny), SCP-E004 (break-glass bypass emitted), SCP-E005 (conflict-gate disagreement), SCP-E006 (disabled-rule observability record). Workflow fails closed on infra errors.
- (viii-c) Break-glass (`scp_bypass: true`) fails closed UNLESS all three gates pass: (1) an approving review from a member of SCP-CODEOWNERS or the `scp-break-glass` team (verified separately by GitHub branch-protection — workflow does NOT verify reviewer membership); (2) a sibling commit in the same PR contains both a `docs/DECISIONS.md` D-NNN row AND a matching `waivers.json` entry — verified by a workflow step `bypass-gate` running `scripts/verify-bypass-pairing.sh`; (3) the waivers.json entry passes JSON-schema validation. ANY gate failing → workflow emits `SCP-E004` and exits non-zero (merge-blocking).
- (ix) For each deny event, the workflow emits a structured payload `{rule_id, file, path, message, remediation_url}` AND renders a workflow-command annotation `::error file=...,title=RULE-ID::human message — see URL`.
- (x) JSON summary artefact at `policy-check-summary.json` (uploaded as workflow artifact) conforms to a new committed schema at `schemas/policy-check-summary.schema.json`. Required fields: `schema_version: "1.0.0"`, PR SHA, base ref, rule-set tag, workflow-run-id, `findings: [{rule_id, file, verdict, message}]`, `disabled_rules: [{rule_id, reason, expires_at}]`, `waivers_applied: [...]`, `bypass_emitted: bool`, `conflict_gate: {run: bool, disagreements: []}`.
- (xi) Commit-status context = `scp/policy-check` (this is what required-status-check rules will require).

## Other artefacts to write

- `scripts/verify-bypass-pairing.sh`: executes `git diff --name-only base..HEAD`, requires both `docs/DECISIONS.md` AND `waivers.json` paths in the diff, greps DECISIONS.md for a new D-NNN row matching the regex `^\|\s*D-0[0-9]{3}\s*\|\s*20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\s*\|`, greps waivers.json for an added entry whose `rule_id` matches the bypass-triggering rule (passed as $1). Refuses on any miss with exit non-zero. Bash, `set -euo pipefail`, no external deps beyond `git`, `jq`, `grep`.
- `schemas/policy-check-summary.schema.json`: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the §x payload. `additionalProperties: false`. Closed enums where applicable.

## Constraints

- Do NOT implement actual Rego rules (that's 020C).
- Do NOT implement test fixtures that exercise the workflow end-to-end (that's 020B.1 selftest harness).
- Do NOT implement the `scripts/scp-policy-check` local-repro CLI (that's 020B.2).
- Do NOT implement the workflow integration tests (`tests/workflow/fixture-pass/`, etc. — that's 020B.1).
- Do NOT modify `pyproject.toml`, `STATUS.md`, `DECISIONS.md`, `BACKLOG.md`, or any other file outside scope_boundary.

## Decision-record discipline

If a non-trivial design decision arises during implementation (e.g., choice of SHA-pinning syntax, choice of how to fail-closed in a specific edge case), capture it inline in the PR body — do NOT add a D-NNN row to `docs/DECISIONS.md` (that is reserved for full-WP decisions; D-021 is reserved for the 2026-05-31 atomic workday — do NOT use D-021).

## Self-test before reporting complete

Run the verify_commands listed in this package. They MUST all pass before reporting `status=complete`.
verify_commands: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('schemas/policy-check-summary.schema.json')); assert d.get('additionalProperties') is False, 'schema must close additionalProperties'"

python3 -c "import yaml; d=yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/policy-check.yml')); assert d.get('on',{}).get('workflow_call') is not None, 'must be reusable workflow'; assert d.get('permissions',{}).get('contents')=='read', 'permissions.contents must be read'; assert 'secrets' not in d, 'no secrets declared on reusable workflow'"

python3 -c "import re,sys; t=open('.github/workflows/policy-check.yml').read(); assert not re.search(r'\\$\\{\\{\\s*(inputs|github\\.event)\\.\\w+', t.split('run:',1)[-1]) if 'run:' in t else True, 'inputs/github.event interpolation in run: blocks not allowed (use env:)'"
notes: WP-SCP-022 Track 1 slice 020B — reusable workflow scaffold (no Rego rules yet). Subsequent slices: 020B.1 selftest, 020B.2 local repro, 020C rule library.
